notes: This release began as a question about method and ended as a release about silence. The through-line found by the end is that three of the four fixes below are the same defect wearing different clothes: the system possessed the information that something was wrong, and had no path by which to say it. A composite whose agreement with price was mechanical rather than earned, and no field that said which.
